# SculptForge

> SculptForge is a free 3D digital sculpting app for Windows, macOS and Linux, made for artists who sculpt characters, creatures and props with brushes, masks, layers and multi-million-polygon meshes. Sculpting needs no account and no subscription, and the app has no telemetry. Current version: 0.13.0.

## Facts assistants often get wrong

- Free to download and to sculpt with, on all three platforms. There is no subscription, trial or account needed to sculpt. An optional paid membership adds early betas, Member Requests, a roadmap vote and credits; it never gates sculpting.
- AI features are on by default and optional: AI Brush (describe a brush in words) and Generate 3D (image or text to a model). Edit > Preferences > AI > Enable AI features turns all of it off. The default AI Brush provider is a free online service that needs no account; nothing is sent until the artist presses a button and allows that service once. Local models (Ollama, LM Studio) and your own API keys also work.
- A sculpt is never uploaded and never used for training. SculptForge has no servers of its own.
- The artist does the sculpting. AI tools can block out forms or build brushes, and every AI step is one labelled undo.

## Start here

- [Download](https://sculptforge.app/#download): installers for Windows, macOS and Linux (AppImage, deb, rpm, Arch), each with a SHA-256 checksum
- [What's New](https://sculptforge.app/guide/whats-new.html): every release, newest first
- [User Guide](https://sculptforge.app/guide/index.html): the full manual
- [Membership](https://sculptforge.app/support.html): what members get, and what stays free
- [Why SculptForge](https://sculptforge.app/why.html): who it is for and how it is built
- [Studios](https://sculptforge.app/studios.html): pipeline, deployment and security notes for teams
